name: SalesForecastCommitBoard
tagline: The Sales Forecast Commit Board turns a list of opportunities into the view a sales manager needs for the weekly forecast call.
description: The Sales Forecast Commit Board turns a list of opportunities into the view a sales manager needs for the weekly forecast call. For the month, quarter or fiscal year you pick, every rep (or team) gets one row with their quota, what is already Closed won, what they Commit to, their Best case and the rest of the Pipeline. A bar shows how far Closed + Commit + Best case reach against the quota marker, and the board works out the forecast, the gap to quota, the pipeline coverage and a status of On track, At risk or Behind.
features: Quota vs Closed won / Commit / Best case / Pipeline per rep or team for a month
Attainment bars with a quota marker
Drill-down deal lists with one-click forecast category changes (single or bulk)
